assets.name: jab_burst
assets.prompt: Create a production game VFX flipbook PNG with true transparent background. Clean flat hand-drawn anime fighting-game effects, purposeful asymmetrical angular pointed shapes and large negative spaces, sparse lime inner accent with purple body, tiny ivory initial core. No glow haze, no grain, no confetti, no text, no grid lines, no backdrop. Exactly 4 columns by 4 rows, row-major 16-frame chronological animation. Every equal square cell uses fixed camera and pivot with minimum 15% transparent padding. Animation: small ignition frames 1-2, strong expanding contact burst frames 3-5, split and outward travel frames 6-11, very sparse dissipating fragments frames 12-16. The silhouettes must change shape, not simply scale. Preserve empty margins between frames. Original isolated artwork, no characters. Compact punch hit with 4 broad spiky petals, diamond centre, explosive broken four-point silhouette, asymmetrical.
